stem: A specialist has high confidence in the pest identity, but pesticide selection and application are outside the specialist's assigned authority. What is the correct handoff?
choices: Select and apply a product anyway because diagnostic confidence grants treatment authority.
Delay documentation until someone approves a pesticide.
Document identity confidence, evidence, scope, containment and monitoring needs, then escalate treatment selection/application to the authorized role under current label, law and facility procedure.
Recommend any product sold for a similar greenhouse pest.
rationale: Accurate identification and treatment authority are separate controls; regulated product selection and application must remain with the authorized role under current label, law and facility procedure.
